_about: Candidate castings per character, rendered on one signature line so they can be compared by ear. Option A is always the current casting in src/data/cast.ts. Kokoro stock voices only: shaped toward each actor's register, pace and energy, never cloned from a recording.

scarn.direction: Mid-high, bright, fast, eager; leans on punchlines; a touch nasal.
scarn.line: No. I don't need a bag. But these guys are gonna need a mop. Because it looks like there's gonna be a clean... Hey! That is my line!

samuel.who: Dwight Schrute as Samuel L. Chang
samuel.direction: Intense, clipped, literal, slightly nasal; very sure of himself.
samuel.line: Sir. Sir! Wake up, sir. Question: are you dead? False. You are breathing. I have ironed your cape.

goldenface.direction: Relaxed, dry, deadpan, mid-low; reading the villain lines off a cue card.
goldenface.line: You want to know why my face is gold, Scarn? I worked at a gold factory. They didn't let us eat. So I ate the gold.

narrator.direction: Very deep, slow, flat, unimpressed; reading it because he is paid to.
narrator.line: He saved the NFL All-Star Game. The NBA All-Star Game. And the M B A All-Star Game. That is what it says. I just read it.

president.direction: Deep, smooth, chill; evil but unbothered.
president.line: Scarn. Thanks for coming in, man. Have a seat. Or stand. You do you.
